versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If • HW timestamping is disabled, CanTSyn shall after successful capture of T4 (refer to [SWS_CanTSyn_00145]): 1. capture the current Virtual Local Time via StbM_GetCurrentVirtualLocal- Time from StbM as T3 VLT and 2. calculate TL Sync = (T0 + T4) + (T3 VLT - T2 VLT )

{DRAFT} For a Time Slave, on invocation of CanTSyn_- RxIndication for a SYNC message • and if CanTSynHardwareTimestampSupport is set to TRUE • and if the StbM uses the CAN controller hardware counter as Virtual Local Time source for the Time Base (refer to StbMLocalTimeClock ), CanTSyn shall • set T2 VLT part of the Rx Time Tuple to the value of T1 VLT (i.e., T2 VLT = T1 VLT ) • and set the SYNC reception delay T SRD to 0.
